d:
High-energy Punjabi-Hindi rap celebrating wealth, power, and cultural pride. With trap beats and catchy hooks, it highlights themes of hustle, lavish lifestyles, and street dominance, symbolized by the black car loaded with cash. The song blends rural grit with urban class, showcasing swagger and cultural identity.

Written & Performed By: Ajitesh Bhati - Ghaint Jxtt
